name: DepthLoot
description:
About This Game

A BACKPACK IS SMALLER THAN YOUR GREED

Before you head down, decide what to bring: weapons, a pickaxe, food, and potions - or leave some space for loot. Items take up slots of different shapes, so good loot forces you to rearrange your entire backpack. Sometimes the best trophy is the one that requires you to leave something useful behind.

THE DEEPER YOU GO, THE BETTER THE LOOT

Explore the dungeon tile by tile and choose your own path. The deeper you go, the more valuable the finds - and the higher the cost of a mistake. When your backpack is almost full, the next door becomes the key question of the expedition: Is this enough, or should you explore one more room?

GET OUT ALIVE

Finding treasure is only half the battle. To claim your loot, you must reach the portal and return to base. If you die in the dungeon, you’ll lose almost everything you didn’t leave in a safe place. Every successful run ends with a choice: take another risk or keep what you’ve found.

TURN LOOT INTO POWER

A successful evacuation isn’t the end - it’s preparation for the next one. Sell what you’ve found, repair worn-out gear, and keep making improvements: more space, more room for error, more training options. The risk of today’s mission becomes a resource for the next one.

Key Features

  • Turn-based expeditions into procedurally generated dungeons.

  • Extraction loop: Loot is only valuable if you make it out alive.

  • Grid-based inventory management with items of various shapes, equipment, a backpack, and a storage area.

  • Weapons, armor, rings, food, potions, keys, pickaxes, valuable resources, and much more.

  • Item durability, repairs at the merchant, and efficient use of every inventory slot.

  • Progression between runs: health, stamina, trading, backpack size, storage, new abilities, and much more.

DepthLoot is about that moment when your backpack is already full, you've found the exit, but there’s surely something behind the next door that’s too valuable to just walk away from.
short_desc: DepthLoot is a compact dungeon extraction about greed, risk, and a backpack that’s always too small. Descend into the ruins, light up the darkness, loot treasures, battle enemies, and make it out alive - or everything you’ve found will be left behind in the depths.
